author: Vika
text:
I want to say that you gave every member of the team unforgettable emotions! 🌊✨ An active holiday like this, on a week-long regatta, is the perfect way to spend time, and I now recommend it to my friends! 😍

Because on it you get a whole range of different emotions and experience. You meet new people, spend several days with them in what you could call a confined space, and because of that, by the middle of the holiday, you get the feeling that you've known these people for a very long time and you really do become a family and a team for that time 🥹

It was very interesting to figure out and learn the finer points of handling a 15-metre yacht, and it's great that you gave time to each of us, explained and taught us how to raise the anchor, steer the boat, moor and much more. The holiday turned out so varied and colourful, we managed to swim and sunbathe and learn yachting and get to know each other, chat, go out to dinners, cook breakfasts and gaze at the beautiful landscapes of Turkey beyond the rail ✨ 😍

For me it was super fun, beautiful and educational. You are a great captain and organiser, I really hope to sail away from the shore with you many more times 🫂❤️
